purpose: Teach: 原型/員数/及ぶ/お上/摘発/人並み/語り口/長らく

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、犯行の、絶対、原型、絶対、解明、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've resolved the case thoroughly. Thank you sincerely.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Even tone. Opens with quiet assurance, no performance. Steady eye contact level throughout. The voice of someone used to briefings.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、員数、絶対、増員、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're truly grateful for the additional resources and support.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight lean forward. Warm but formal. Acknowledgment without over-politeness. The tone of someone listening to a brief they respect.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、捜査、絶対、広範囲、絶対、及ぶ、絶対、見込みです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The investigation will span a wide area. We're prepared to conduct a thorough search.
lines.style: Clear, procedural. Confident but not boastful. Each phrase lands with quiet competence. Slight pause between thoughts. The delivery of someone outlining next steps.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、お上、絶対、の、絶対、方針、絶対、警察、絶対、ご対応ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We appreciate the department's consistent support and direction.
lines.style: Formal nod in the voice. Respectful but not deferential. Steady pace. Slight emphasis on 'appreciate'—genuine, not rote. The politeness of a professional to a colleague.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、不正、絶対、摘発、絶対、強化、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're strengthening our efforts to crack down on any irregularities.
lines.style: Firm but not aggressive. Slight emphasis on 'strengthening.' Clear, direct tone. The voice of someone stating a commitment they've already acted on.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、人並み、絶対、以上、絶対、巡回、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the increased patrols in the community.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Quiet sincerity. Slight nod in the voice. The tone of someone meaning what he's saying, not performing gratitude.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、市民、絶対、語り口、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、応対します、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We'll continue to engage with citizens respectfully and carefully.
lines.style: Composed, clear commitment. Open tone—slight warmth beneath professionalism. Measured pace. The voice of someone whose word is steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、長らく、絶対、地域、絶対、お守り、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're truly thankful for your years of protecting this community.
lines.style: Warm, genuine. Slight softening on 'truly thankful'—not effusive, but sincere. Slower pace on the final phrase. The gratitude of someone who means it.
